exact_arithmetic: half-integer bound plus strict bit; plus(a,b)=a+b+((a&1)&(b&1))
triangle_arms: outer difference >= 1, middle strictly between outer chords
optimization: native exact closure; original-atom bitsets; in-place forced saturation; completed UNSAT state memo
memo_key: complete exact cost matrix and remaining triangle IDs; proofs not reused
provenance: every directly found negative-cycle core retains original atom bitset
memo_certificate_limitation: cached state UNSAT decisions require fresh provenance or Lean transport before proof export

potential_proof_export.first_step: Replay the same deterministic search while retaining every forced rejected atom core, survivor orientation, and binary branch tree; disable memo for proof export.
potential_proof_export.ordinary_Lean_route: Fresh eleven-point model plus resolve_left/resolve_right and linarith only, adapting the frozen nine-point exporter without changing its sources.
potential_proof_export.sharding_route: Cut complete proof tree into fresh shards with at most 300 negative-cycle checks each, then trust=0 compile all shards and root.

linear_heuristic_only.limitations: No tree persistence, actual shard cuts, source generation, or eleven-point Lean compilation has been performed.

post_run_robustness_fix.description: Move base-edge and memo-key native calls outside assert expressions and reject Python -O; normal default execution is unchanged.
